reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Good face masks with a good composition, I will buy more of these masks.
reviews.zh: 好嘅面膜，成分好，會再回購多啲。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: This was very soothing and hydrating to use would buy again
reviews.zh: 用落好舒緩、好保濕，會再買。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Compared to Mediheal sheet masks this is just average qnd gave me a little stink as well
reviews.zh: 同 Mediheal 嘅面膜比起，呢款只係一般，而且有少少臭味。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: First time using SOME BY MI masks! The sheet is soft and stays perfectly on the face. I purchased a few different functional types, and Cica was definitely the best fit for my skin.
reviews.zh: 第一次用 SOME BY MI 嘅面膜！面膜紙好柔軟，完美貼合塊面。我買咗幾款唔同功能嘅，Cica 嗰款最啱我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I loved this mask, not sure about the brightening effects I believe you have to use it consistently to see the results but at least it gives a glow boost after the first use
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款面膜，提亮效果就唔太確定，我覺得要持續用先見到效果，但至少第一次用完之後皮膚光澤提升咗。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I was curious to try glutathione and must say I was not disappointed. My sensitive skin thanks me now 🤣
reviews.zh: 本來對 glutathione 好有興趣想試下，必須講句冇令我失望。我嘅敏感肌而家要多謝我 🤣

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Not too sure if it’s brightening. But definitely hydrating.
reviews.zh: 唔太確定有冇提亮效果，但保濕就一定有。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Glutathione Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I really enjoyed using this mask! The fabric is very thin and soft, which makes it feel high-quality and comfortable on the skin. It adheres perfectly to my face without sliding off. After using it, my skin felt refreshed and looked brighter. It’s a great addition to my routine for targeting dark spots and getting that healthy glow. Highly recommended!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意用呢款面膜！面膜紙好薄好軟，感覺高質，貼住皮膚好舒服。可以完美貼合塊面，唔會滑落。用完皮膚感覺煥然一新，望落更加亮澤。加入日常護膚流程用嚟針對色斑同健康光澤，極度推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
